checks.claim: Ward 250 reached zero-power criticality in Utah. Valar later announced a 30 MW Utah data-center project with Nvidia; no public power contract, price, or delivery date was found.
checks.evidence: East Idaho News (2026-10-01, KSL story): Valar's Project Beehive would include 456 small nuclear reactors and, per NPR-reported documents, could produce 9.6 gigawatts. The BLM confirmed Valar filed an initial application for an industrial campus of about 9,000 acres near Price, Utah; the BLM would run a Notice of Realty Action, NEPA analysis and public comment if it finds the application complete. Utah's Trust Lands board approved a lease of more than 640 acres of state land in Carbon County on 2026-09-17. The article does not mention Nvidia or 30 MW, so that half of the shipped claim is neither confirmed nor contradicted.
checks.correction: Ward 250 reached zero-power criticality in Utah. Valar later filed an initial BLM application for a campus near Price, UT (Project Beehive: 456 reactors, 9.6 GW per NPR-reported documents); it is not yet approved. The Nvidia 30 MW claim was not re-checked.
